# Agave Welding & Railings LLC

> Agave Welding & Railings LLC is a licensed welding contractor serving the greater Seattle area,
> including Everett, Tacoma, Arlington, Snohomish, Marysville, and Edmonds, WA.
> Owner: Jorge Villegas. Phone: (425) 446-1638. Website: https://agavewelding.com
> Certifications: WABO structural welding (Washington Association of Building Officials), OSHA 10-hour safety.
> Licensed and bonded for residential and commercial projects.

## Services

- Custom Metal Fabrication: https://agavewelding.com/
- Custom Railings & Handrails: https://agavewelding.com/
- Structural Steel Welding: https://agavewelding.com/
- Welding Repairs: https://agavewelding.com/
- Powder Coating: https://agavewelding.com/
- Commercial Projects: https://agavewelding.com/
